question: What rite must be performed at the end of the impurity period?
premises: The period of ritual impurity comes to an end.
A specific śrāddha is prescribed at that point.
The rite is directed to a single deceased person.
inference: At the end of impurity, the single-directed śrāddha must be performed.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, at the end of the impurity period the single-directed rite should be performed.
